doc.title: Eddie Bert interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001

title: Joining Stan Kenton in 1947
summary: Played a Kenton record; Bert joined for the trombone features and the poll-winning players.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Big band discipline versus small-group freedom

blocks.x: I wanted to play a little piece here. See if it jogs your memory.
Well I know it’s Stan’s band.
And you’re on this, I think around ’46 or so.
All right. ’47. What did you think of his music?

Well he featured trombones. That’s why I wanted to go with that band. And he was very popular. I mean guys were poll winners in the band, like Shelly Manne and Art Pepper and all them. So I figured well let me go. Because Kai had done great on the band and Kai and I were friends. So I went with the band. And it was like a family that band. It was great. He was a great guy to work for. Great.
